title: A foundation model for clinician-centered drug repurposing

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《A foundation model for clinician-centered drug repurposing》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-9】TxGNN's drug-repurposing predictions are accurate, consistent with off-label drug use, and can be investigated by human experts through multi-hop interpretable rationales.

evidence.text: TxGNN's drug-repurposing predictions are accurate, consistent with off-label drug use, and can be investigated by human experts through multi-hop interpretable rationales.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《A foundation model for clinician-centered drug repurposing》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-4】Trained on a medical knowledge graph, TxGNN uses a graph neural network and metric learning module to rank drugs as potential indications and contraindications for 17,080 diseases.

evidence.text: Trained on a medical knowledge graph, TxGNN uses a graph neural network and metric learning module to rank drugs as potential indications and contraindications for 17,080 diseases.

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《A foundation model for clinician-centered drug repurposing》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-5】When benchmarked against 8 methods, TxGNN improves prediction accuracy for indications by 49.2% and contraindications by 35.1% under stringent zero-shot evaluation.

【Abstract · abstract-1-7】Human evaluation of TxGNN's Explainer showed that TxGNN's predictions and explanations perform encouragingly on multiple axes of performance beyond accuracy.

evidence.text: When benchmarked against 8 methods, TxGNN improves prediction accuracy for indications by 49.2% and contraindications by 35.1% under stringent zero-shot evaluation.
Human evaluation of TxGNN's Explainer showed that TxGNN's predictions and explanations perform encouragingly on multiple axes of performance beyond accuracy.
